no_doubles.desc: doubled letters such as 'aa' are missing from the dictionary
patch: combinations = permutations + [x*2 for x in ALPHABETS]
no_doubles.why_undecided: the docstring says the keys are generated with itertools.permutations (650 keys, no 'aa') but also 'all possible two-letter combinations'

non_overlapping.desc: counts non-overlapping occurrences, so 'aaa' gives aa = 1
patch: return {key: word_counter.get(key, 0) for key in combinations}
return {key: word.count(key) for key in combinations}
non_overlapping.why_undecided: the docstring does not say whether overlapping occurrences are counted

reversed_pairs.desc: pairs are read right-to-left, so 'abcdef' counts 'ba' instead of 'ab' (contradicts the docstring example)

casefold_input.desc: lower-cases the word first; behaviour on uppercase input is unspecified

ambiguity: The docstring generates keys with itertools.permutations (650, no doubled letters) yet promises all two-letter combinations; the reference and upstream tests use 676. Overlap counting is unstated.
